title: Taiwan Will Pay Employers Who Let Parents Work Shorter Days
summaryZh: 勞動部明年起補助讓育兒員工減少工時且不減薪的雇主。
summaryHi: ताइवान 2027 से उन नियोक्ताओं को सब्सिडी देगा जो माता-पिता को बिना वेतन घटाए कम घंटे काम करने देंगे।
summaryEs: Taiwán subvencionará desde 2027 a las empresas que reduzcan la jornada de los padres sin bajarles el sueldo.
summaryJa: 台湾労働部、来年から子育て中の社員の勤務時間を減給なしで短縮した雇用主に補助金。
summaryKo: 대만 노동부가 내년부터 육아 직원의 근무시간을 임금 삭감 없이 줄여 주는 고용주에게 보조금을 준다.
summaryEn: From January 2027, Taiwan will subsidise employers who cut parents' working hours without cutting their pay.
paragraphs: Taiwan's Ministry of Labor has unveiled a subsidy scheme for employers who allow parents to shorten their working day without any reduction in pay, as the government tries to make it easier to combine a job with raising children.

Under the scheme, the employee must have a child under 12, and their workday must be cut by at least an hour on a minimum of 10 days per month for three months or more. Employers can then claim one hour's wages for each qualifying day, up to NT$45,000 per employee a year.

Additional support is available for related costs. Companies that pay colleagues to cover shifts can claim up to NT$800 a day, while businesses with fewer than 200 employees can receive NT$20,000 to hire a replacement for a worker on maternity or unpaid parental leave.

Smaller firms that adopt flexible schedules or remote working may also receive one-off awards of NT$100,000 or NT$150,000, depending on their size. Applications open on 1 January 2027, and nearly NT$5.9 billion has been set aside in next year's budget.

The announcement comes as Taiwan's population declined for a 34th consecutive month in October, when just 8,035 births were recorded. A parents' advocacy group praised the plan but warned that some parents may still hesitate to use it in unsupportive workplaces.
Taiwan wants to help working parents. The government will give money to companies that let parents work shorter days.
The parent must have a child under 12. The workday must be at least one hour shorter. The parent must still get the same pay.
The company can get one hour of pay back for each short day. This must happen on 10 days a month or more, for three months.
Small companies can also get money to hire a worker when a mother or father takes leave. Companies that let people work from home can get a prize too.
The plan starts on 1 January 2027. Fewer babies are born in Taiwan every year. The government hopes this plan will help families.
sentZh: 台灣想幫助上班的父母。

父母必須有一個未滿 12 歲的孩子。
每天的工作時間必須至少少一個小時。
父母仍然必須拿到一樣的薪水。
每縮短一天，公司可以拿回一小時的薪資。
這必須每個月至少有 10 天，並持續三個月。
當媽媽或爸爸請假時，小公司也可以拿到補助來僱用人手。
讓員工在家工作的公司也可以得到獎勵。
這項計畫從 2027 年 1 月 1 日開始。
台灣每年出生的嬰兒越來越少。
政府希望這項計畫能幫助家庭。

paragraphs: Taiwan's Ministry of Labor says it will give money to employers who let parents work fewer hours without losing any pay. The plan was announced on Tuesday.
To qualify, a worker must have a child under the age of 12. Their workday must be cut by at least one hour, on at least 10 days a month, for at least three months.

For each of these days, the employer can claim one hour of wages. The limit is NT$45,000 per worker each year. Companies can also get up to NT$800 a day for paying colleagues who cover the extra work.

Businesses with fewer than 200 staff can receive NT$20,000 to hire someone while a worker is on maternity or parental leave. Small firms that offer flexible hours or working from home can win up to NT$150,000.

Applications open on 1 January 2027. Taiwan's population has fallen for 34 months in a row, and only 8,035 babies were born in October. A parents' group welcomed the plan but said some workplaces still do not support families.
sentZh: 台灣勞動部表示，將補助讓父母減少工時又不減薪的雇主。
這項計畫於星期二公布。
要符合資格，員工必須有未滿 12 歲的孩子。
他們的工作日必須至少縮短一小時，每月至少 10 天，並持續至少三個月。
每符合一天，雇主可以申請一小時的薪資。
上限是每名員工每年新台幣 4 萬 5 千元。
公司若付錢請同事分擔額外工作，每天最多也可領取新台幣 800 元。
員工未滿 200 人的企業，在員工請產假或育嬰假期間，可獲得新台幣 2 萬元來僱用人手。
提供彈性工時或在家工作的小公司，最高可獲得新台幣 15 萬元獎勵。
申請將於 2027 年 1 月 1 日開始。
台灣人口已連續 34 個月減少，十月只有 8,035 名嬰兒出生。
一個家長團體歡迎這項計畫，但表示有些職場仍不支持家庭。

Under the scheme, the employee must have a child under 12, and their workday must be cut by at least an hour on a minimum of 10 days per month for three months or more. Employers can then claim one hour's wages for each qualifying day, up to NT$45,000 per employee a year.

Additional support is available for related costs. Companies that pay colleagues to cover shifts can claim up to NT$800 a day, while businesses with fewer than 200 employees can receive NT$20,000 to hire a replacement for a worker on maternity or unpaid parental leave.

Smaller firms that adopt flexible schedules or remote working may also receive one-off awards of NT$100,000 or NT$150,000, depending on their size. Applications open on 1 January 2027, and nearly NT$5.9 billion has been set aside in next year's budget.

The announcement comes as Taiwan's population declined for a 34th consecutive month in October, when just 8,035 births were recorded. A parents' advocacy group praised the plan but warned that some parents may still hesitate to use it in unsupportive workplaces.
sentZh: 台灣勞動部推出一項補助方案，對象是讓父母縮短每日工時且不減薪的雇主，政府希望讓工作與育兒更容易兼顧。
根據方案，員工必須有未滿 12 歲的孩子，且每月至少 10 天、每天至少減少一小時工時，並持續三個月以上。

相關成本也有額外補助。
付錢請同事代班的公司每天最多可申請新台幣 800 元，員工未滿 200 人的企業則可獲得新台幣 2 萬元，用來為請產假或留職停薪育嬰假的員工僱用替代人力。
採用彈性工時或遠距工作的小型企業，依規模大小還可獲得新台幣 10 萬或 15 萬元的一次性獎勵。
申請將於 2027 年 1 月 1 日開始，明年預算已編列近新台幣 59 億元。
宣布之際，台灣人口在十月已連續第 34 個月減少，當月僅登記 8,035 名新生兒。

paragraphs: Taiwan's Ministry of Labor has introduced a subsidy programme aimed at employers who permit parents to work shorter days with no loss of income, part of a broader effort to ease the strain of balancing employment and childcare.

Eligibility hinges on several conditions. The employee must be raising a child under 12, and their daily hours must be reduced by at least one hour on no fewer than 10 days a month over a period of at least three months. Employers may then reclaim one hour's wages per qualifying day, capped at NT$45,000 per employee annually.

The package also addresses knock-on costs. Firms that compensate colleagues for covering shifts can claim up to NT$800 a day, and businesses with fewer than 200 staff are entitled to NT$20,000 to recruit a temporary replacement for someone on maternity or unpaid parental leave.

In addition, smaller companies that implement flexible scheduling or remote working are eligible for one-off grants of NT$100,000 or NT$150,000, depending on headcount. Applications open on 1 January 2027, with roughly NT$5.9 billion earmarked in the proposed budget.

The measures arrive against the backdrop of a persistent demographic decline: October marked the 34th consecutive month of population shrinkage, with only 8,035 births. While a parents' advocacy group welcomed the initiative, it cautioned that unsupportive workplace cultures could still deter parents and urged the ministry to publish take-up figures.
sentZh: 台灣勞動部推出一項補助計畫，對象是允許父母縮短工時且收入不受影響的雇主，這是減輕工作與育兒兩頭燒壓力的更大政策的一部分。
申請資格取決於幾項條件。
員工必須正在撫養未滿 12 歲的孩子，且每天工時須減少至少一小時，每月不少於 10 天，為期至少三個月。
雇主即可就每個符合條件的日子領回一小時工資，每名員工每年上限新台幣 4 萬 5 千元。
這套方案也處理了連帶產生的成本。
補償同事代班的公司每天最多可申請新台幣 800 元，員工未滿 200 人的企業則可獲新台幣 2 萬元，用以招募臨時人員替代請產假或留職停薪育嬰假的員工。
此外，實施彈性排班或遠距工作的小型公司，依員工人數可獲一次性補助新台幣 10 萬或 15 萬元。
申請將於 2027 年 1 月 1 日開始，擬議預算中已編列約新台幣 59 億元。
這些措施推出的背景是人口持續下滑：十月是人口連續第 34 個月減少，出生數僅 8,035 人。
一個家長倡議團體雖然歡迎這項計畫，但提醒不友善的職場文化仍可能讓父母卻步，並敦促勞動部公布使用人數。

paragraphs: Taiwan's Ministry of Labor has launched a subsidy initiative targeting employers who enable parents to work reduced hours without forfeiting any income, a measure designed to alleviate the persistent tension between career obligations and childcare responsibilities.

The criteria for eligibility are relatively stringent. Employees must be raising a child under the age of 12, and their working day must be curtailed by at least one hour on a minimum of 10 days per month for no less than three consecutive months. Employers are then entitled to reimbursement equivalent to one hour's wages per qualifying day, subject to an annual ceiling of NT$45,000 per employee.

The scheme also mitigates ancillary expenses. Companies that remunerate colleagues for absorbing additional duties may claim up to NT$800 daily, while enterprises with fewer than 200 employees can obtain NT$20,000 to recruit a substitute for staff on maternity or unpaid parental leave.

Furthermore, smaller firms that adopt flexible scheduling or remote working arrangements qualify for one-off incentives of NT$100,000 or NT$150,000, contingent on their workforce size. Applications commence on 1 January 2027, with approximately NT$5.9 billion allocated in the forthcoming budget.

These measures coincide with an alarming demographic trajectory: October marked the 34th consecutive month of population decline, with merely 8,035 births registered. Although a parental advocacy organisation endorsed the policy, it warned that entrenched workplace attitudes might still discourage uptake and called for greater transparency regarding participation rates.
sentZh: 台灣勞動部推出一項補助措施，鎖定讓父母減少工時又不損失收入的雇主，目的是緩解職涯責任與育兒責任之間長期存在的拉扯。
申請資格相對嚴格。
員工必須正在撫養未滿 12 歲的孩子，且每月至少 10 天、每天工時至少縮減一小時，並連續不少於三個月。
雇主即可獲得相當於每個符合條件日子一小時工資的補償，每名員工每年上限新台幣 4 萬 5 千元。
該方案也減輕了附帶開支。
支付同事酬勞以分擔額外工作的公司，每天最多可申請新台幣 800 元；員工未滿 200 人的企業則可獲新台幣 2 萬元，用來招募人員替代請產假或留職停薪育嬰假的員工。
此外，採用彈性排班或遠距工作安排的小型企業，可依員工規模獲得新台幣 10 萬或 15 萬元的一次性獎勵。
申請將於 2027 年 1 月 1 日開始，即將實施的預算中已撥出約新台幣 59 億元。
這些措施恰逢令人憂心的人口趨勢：十月是人口連續第 34 個月下降，登記出生數僅 8,035 人。
雖然一個家長倡議組織支持這項政策，但它警告根深蒂固的職場觀念仍可能降低申請意願，並呼籲提高參與率資訊的透明度。
